description: Single source of truth for boolean capability flags. Run 'node tools/add-capability.js <flagName> "description"' to add a new one.

comments.providerFlags: Exposed in PlatformCapabilities. UI components gate on these via usePlatformCapabilities(). Regenerate capability providers with: nx run <platform>:sync-capabilities
comments.routeFlags: Affect route generation only (e.g. sites picker). NOT in PlatformCapabilities and NOT visible to UI components.
